_comment: arm64-smoke is a KERNEL-ONLY product (no userboot.next, no PSCI item): the defined success is reaching the four kernel serial markers, after which the root job exits -> reboot fails (no PSCI) -> a benign 'HALT: spinning forever (reason = 6)'. Forbidden markers therefore must NOT include bare 'HALT' (the normal terminal state) nor bare 'fatal' (it substring-matches the benign lockup_detector line 'fatal threshold ...'). They are narrowed to real crash signatures. Verified against a live boot.
